properties.description: One of the finest surviving Elizabethan red brick Manor houses- Grade I listed. Many original features have been restored and layout remains mostly unchanged in over 400 years.

properties.description: The Society of Antiquaries of London has been exploring the material past since the early eighteenth century. In the 1870s, the Society set up home in purpose-built grade II* listed apartments in Burlington House, with a grand galleried library housing 130,000 books. Today's membership of 3,000 Fellows are leading experts in archaeology, history, art, architecture, and heritage.

properties.description: St Anne's Limehouse has been described as 'the finest parish church in England.' Designed by Nicholas Hawksmoor, it is Grade I listed and one of the Major Churches in the Church of England. It is home to a thriving Christian congregation.

properties.description: Explore Southlands Arts Centre and discover the history and architecture of this Grade II listed Queen Anne-style building. Admire its distinctive red-brick façade, elegant decorative detailing and historic interiors, and learn how this former private residence has evolved into a thriving community arts centre, celebrating Hillingdon's rich architectural and cultural heritage.
properties.name: Southlands Arts Centre

properties.description: Ibraaz is a London-based cultural institution for art,  culture and ideas from the Global Majority. Bringing together artists, thinkers, and communities through exhibitions, film, debate, publishing, and multidisciplinary programming, Ibraaz creates a brave space where culture fosters exchange, pluralism, and shared humanity.
properties.name: Ibraaz

properties.description: A slow storytelling amble across three key neighbourhoods: Bloomsbury, Fitzrovia, Holborn and down to the river Thames to discover the the history of the key institutions that have evolved to ensure a thriving citizenry and caring infrastructure open to all and often taken for granted.

properties.description:
For one day only, the charity Refugees at Home is holding a special photography exhibition at their home, International House. 

'Home Between Homes: The Faces Behind Hosting' showcases the stories of ordinary people who have opened their own homes to refugees.
properties.name: Refugees at Home at International House

properties.description:
We are a friendly artist run gallery in Wells Street offering affordable, handmade fine art prints with a broad range of subjects created using many different printmaking techniques.
We aim to encourage people who have never encountered art before to experience printmaking through our regular workshops.
properties.name: Southbank Printmakers

properties.description: This walk will look at the history of Jewish Communities in England, starting with the medieval period through to the expulsion in 1290 and readmission under Oliver Cromwell in 1656. It will also look at some of the Jewish people living as Christians between these times and the key contributions Jews have made to many of the key landmarks in London  as well as England's political life.
properties.name: Jewish Westminster

properties.description:
Now in its seventeenth year, Sedici consists of artists from many countries who are now based across England. Working across eclectic mediums and subject matter, this diverse body of artists shares an independent and contemporary purpose highlighting the ongoing strength of Art being made today. 

The gallery itself is a reimagined, mid-century school gymnasium with original details
properties.name: The Annual Sedici Post Grad Group Exhibition

properties.description: A special exhibition exploring the people and places that shaped the area during the Second World War. Tracing famous figures who made Soho their home, and the ordinary everyday heroes who kept the area functioning and our spirits up!
properties.name: The West End At War

properties.description:
Experience London's newest 3,800-capacity music venue at Olympia. This exclusive tour features:

VIP Wing Lounge Access: Stunning stage views

Backstage Tour: A behind-the-scenes look at production areas

Star Dressing Rooms: An exclusive peek inside where headliners prepare
properties.name: Olympia - BA ARC Behind the Scenes Tour with AEG

properties.description: The building has had many incarnations since its construction in the 1890s as a woolen warehouse.   It became a home to the Italian Benevolent Society, then a fascist club, a serviceman's club, and now a library with the largest publicly accessible collection of Chinese language books in the UK.
properties.name: Charing Cross Library
